criteria.text: Multiple sclerosis (MS) treatment to improve walking, demonstrated by increased walking speed (indication and approval criterion 1).
Creatinine clearance (CrCl) >50 mL/min (approval criterion 2; denial criterion 2 mirrors ≤50).
EDSS >4.0 and <7.0 OR difficulty walking but able to walk 25 feet with or without a cane, crutches or braces (approval criterion 3).

notes: Partial encoding of AK Ampyra (dalfampridine) Criteria Version 2. Last updated: 10/14/2010; Approved: 11/19/2010; Reviewed: 09/19/2014 (format & reference update). No explicit effective date is stated; effective_date uses the approval date 2010-11-19.

Encoded: closed MS walking-improvement indication, CrCl >50 mL/min, and the two alternative disability/walking paths in approval criterion 3. No age, specialty or prior MS therapy requirement is stated.

Source wording: denial criteria separately list EDSS ≤4.0 or ≥7.0, no difficulty walking, or wheelchair restriction. The predicate preserves the explicit approval criterion 3 OR; not_met represents failure to qualify, including wheelchair restriction or inability to walk the required distance. The approval/denial wording discrepancy requires manual review.
Length of authorization (notes only): initial approval up to 6 months. Renewal requires meeting the approval criteria AND reporting an increase in walking speed while taking Ampyra.

Dispensing limits (notes only): 30-day supply; quantity limit 2 tablets/day. Documentation verification, authorization duration, renewal response and dispensing/quantity enforcement require manual review.
Reference: Ampyra [package insert]. Ardsley, NY; Acorda Therapeutics, Inc., Jan 2014.
Ampyra treats walking impairment in MS; no disease-modifying MS peer alternatives are specified.
